backend/main.mo: Motoko canister managing authorization, user profiles, parent‑child links, schedules, filters, activity/location logs, audit logs, and admin password operations.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping theme and layout contrast improvements to affected frontend files and component versions.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: List of high‑level summaries for many frontend files including pages, components, hooks, and styling changes.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base stylesheet defining global light/dark theme tokens for backgrounds, surfaces, text, borders, and charts.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML entry file mounting the React app and loading the main module script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app handling authentication, role routing, theme/i18n providers, and landing page for unauthenticated users.
frontend/src/components/admin/AccountsTa: Admin table component for listing users and enabling/disabling accounts with reason input and confirmation dialog.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminPassw: Provides a password gate UI allowing admins to verify or change the admin password using query hooks and form handling.
frontend/src/components/admin/Aggregated: Displays metric summary cards for total users, parents, children, and pairings using provided aggregated metrics.
frontend/src/components/alerts/AlertsPan: Shows a child’s daily usage, alerts if limits are exceeded, and allows submitting a note requesting more time.
Displays a parent-facing view of a child’s daily usage with alerts indicating whether limits were exceeded.
frontend/src/components/audit/AuditLogTa: Fetches and displays sorted audit log entries for a child with action labels, executor, and timestamps.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Handles Internet Identity login/logout, clearing state and updating UI based on authentication status.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Modal dialog for creating a user profile with name and role selection, saving via mutation.
frontend/src/components/child/ActivityHi: Lists a child’s activity history sorted by timestamp, optionally showing a transparency badge.
frontend/src/components/child/ChildCheck: Form component allowing children to submit activity or location check-ins with consent, sending data via mutation hooks.
frontend/src/components/child/ConsentNot: Displays a contextual transparency notice explaining what data will be shared based on the action type.
frontend/src/components/child/LocationHi: Fetches and displays a sortable table of child-submitted locations, optionally showing a transparency label.
frontend/src/components/filters/ContentF: Parent-facing editor to view and update a child's content filter categories, allowlist, and blocklist.
Child-facing read-only view of the content filter policy, showing categories and list entries.
frontend/src/components/i18n/LanguageSel: Dropdown button for switching app language using the i18n hook.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppFooter: Footer showing copyright, transparency policy link, and caffeine.ai attribution.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppHeader: Header displaying app name, user info, theme toggle, language selector, and transparency link.
frontend/src/components/parent/ActivityV: Parent view showing a transparency notice and a child's activity history list.
frontend/src/components/parent/ChildSumm: Card summarizing a child's recent activity and location stats, selectable by the parent.
frontend/src/components/parent/LocationV: Parent view displaying a transparency notice and the child's shared location history.
frontend/src/components/parent/PairingSe: UI to generate a mock pairing code and copy a pairing link, with notes that backend pairing APIs are not implemented.
frontend/src/components/schedule/Schedul: Editor for parents to set a child’s daily limit and time windows, loading/saving schedule through backend queries.
Read-only display of a child’s daily limit and allowed time windows fetched from the backend.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches a backend actor tied to the user’s identity, refreshing dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminGate.ts: Simple sessionStorage-based gate for admin access with helpers to pass or clear the gate.
frontend/src/hooks/useI18n.ts: Exports the i18n context hook for accessing translations and language settings.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides identity context, login, and logout via Internet Identity with stored sessions and custom AuthClient options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of react-query hooks for fetching and mutating user profiles, relationships, activities, locations, schedules, and roles via the backend actor.
frontend/src/i18n/I18nProvider.tsx: i18n provider storing language preference, exposing translation function with param replacement.
frontend/src/i18n/index.ts: Exports available locales and translation dictionaries for English and Brazilian Portuguese.
frontend/src/i18n/translations/en.ts: English translation dictionary containing UI text for common actions, landing page, profile setup, transparency policies, and more.
frontend/src/i18n/translations/pt-BR.ts: Brazilian Portuguese translation dictionary mirroring the English keys for UI labels, onboarding, and transparency content.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base styles and custom CSS variables defining a navy-themed light and dark mode color system.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that initializes React, sets up React Query, Internet Identity, and renders the main App component.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminPanel.tsx: Admin interface that gates access, loads users, metrics, and links, and displays management tabs and summaries.
frontend/src/pages/child/ChildHome.tsx: Child dashboard showing supervision notice, pairing status, and tabs for check-ins, history, schedule, filters, and alerts.
frontend/src/pages/parent/ParentDashboar: Parent dashboard page showing child list, consent notice, and tabbed views (activity, location, schedule, filters, alerts, audit) for a selected child.
Modal component displaying transparency and data-handling policies using localized text and structured sections.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utilities for reading, storing, persisting, and clearing URL and session-based parameters with hash routing support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration defining theme colors using CSS variables, custom fonts, animations, and plugin setup.
project_state.json: Project state file tracking schema version, known issues, feature requirements, and pending requests related to UI theme contrast fixes.
